name: Douyin Short Drama
description: Browse and manage Douyin short dramas (短剧): list trending dramas, open a drama, list episodes, play & download episodes. Uses AppleScript + Chrome JS + cliclick + curl.
usage:
PYTHONPATH=~/.claude-manager/toolkits/douyin-drama python3 -c "
from douyin_drama.tools import <func>
print(<func>(...))
"

Available functions:
- list_dramas(category) — list trending short dramas
- open_drama(index) — open a drama from the list (cliclick)
- get_episodes() — get episode list of the current drama
- play_episode(episode) — play a specific episode number
- download_episode(save_path) — download the currently playing episode
- get_drama_info() — get current drama title, episode, stats
- wait() — random 3-5s delay for anti-bot
install: Requires macOS + Google Chrome + cliclick (brew install cliclick) + curl. Accessibility permission required.
